blurb: Guests rent side-by-side vehicles or jet skis to explore nature around Lac-Simon and Duhamel. Guided tours include training, safety briefings, and stops for photos and viewpoints. Activities are suitable for beginners and experienced drivers, with all equipment and insurance included.
extraNote: Security deposit of $4,000 by credit card imprint required · Free cancellation up to 48 hours before; 50% charge between 24 and 48 hours; no refund less than 24 hours · In dangerous weather conditions, outing is cancelled or rescheduled at no charge; cloudy or light rain activity goes ahead · Side-by-side tours depart from base in Duhamel; jet skis depart from Lac-Simon.
